definition: אַכְשָׁף proper name, of a location in (Northern) Canaan, with a king Josh 11:1 ; Josh 12:20 situated on the border of Asher Josh 19:25 , Egyptian 'A-k-sap WMM As.u.Eur.181 ; ᵐ5 B Αζειφ A Ἀχσαφ , ᵐ5 L ( Ἀ ) χασαφ , etc.; site dubious; modern Iksâf or Kesâf , Rob BR iii. 55 , approximately 17 miles east of Tyre, and nearly 3 miles southwest of the great bend of the Litâny, is phonetically suitable, but much too far northeast for Josh 19:25 possibly there were two Akšaphs ; compare Di Josh 11:1 Buhl Geogr.237 . See further Krall Tyrus U. Sidon 10, Lag Onom. 218. 91, 3; 2d ed. 239 .
